summary: The persistent sudo logging configuration was installed and validated, but node1 did not recover its management connection after the safe reboot. Functional logging/isolation and mandatory restart persistence therefore could not be verified.
actions_performed: Confirmed rsyslog was active and enabled, with no existing dedicated sudo log.
Diagnosed all sudo invocations as blocked in the kernel netlink_dump path, including pre-existing provisioning commands.
Validated the complete sudoers configuration successfully with visudo.
Captured the original boot ID and scheduled a native asynchronous reboot.
Polled node1 for several minutes; every attempt continued returning connection reset.

evidence.summary: Shows rsyslog active/enabled, no prior logging override, and no dedicated sudo log.

evidence.requirement: Cause preventing pre-reboot functional sudo testing
evidence.summary: Shows multiple sudo processes, including pre-existing provisioning commands, blocked in uninterruptible netlink_dump.
Shows the exact logfile/log_year/!syslog configuration, successful visudo validation, and secure file metadata.

evidence.requirement: Pre-reboot boot identity and supporting health
evidence.summary: Captures boot ID 267e568a-ef2b-4189-9a7f-50a72b044473, active rsyslog, valid sudoers, and installed configuration.
Confirms the native safe reboot was scheduled asynchronously.
The first and later polls all returned connection reset. A changed boot identity and recovered services/data could not be observed, so restart persistence is not claimed.
